snapshot.text: A government-led health system now rolling out universal health insurance under the 2023 UHI Act. Out-of-pocket costs, a shortage of specialists and falling donor funding are the main challenges; the 2007 Health Policy is under review.

priorities.title: Universal Health Insurance
priorities.text: Rollout began in January 2026 for poor households; the second phase started on 22 October 2026 with the FAHARI AFYA package (TSh 150,000 per household of up to six) and a target of 25 million beneficiaries by mid-2027.

priorities.title: Budget 2026/27: 11 priorities
priorities.text: The TSh 1.8 trillion budget puts universal health insurance, local pharmaceutical manufacturing and specialist care at the centre.

priorities.title: Health sovereignty
priorities.text: Officials frame health sovereignty as a national security matter, and the ministry is revising the 2007 Health Policy and the Health Services Management Act.

netherlands.text: Dutch and German hospitals are working with Benjamin Mkapa Hospital in Dodoma on specialised cardiac care over five years, coordinated by ZGT Overzee. Radboudumc also partners with Muhimbili.
